questions.solution_text:
The coefficient of $x^{n-r}y^{r}$ in $(x+y)^{n}$ is $^{n}C_{r}$.
Here $n = 9$ and $r = 3$:
$^{9}C_{3} = \dfrac{9 \times 8 \times 7}{3 \times 2 \times 1} = 84$.

questions.question_text: Evaluate $^{10}C_{3} + 2{^{10}C_{4}} + {^{10}C_{5}}$ by reducing to a single combination.
questions.solution_text:
Group the terms using Pascal's addition rule:
$({^{10}C_{3}} + {^{10}C_{4}}) + ({^{10}C_{4}} + {^{10}C_{5}})$
$= {^{11}C_{4}} + {^{11}C_{5}}$
$= {^{12}C_{5}}$
$= \dfrac{12 \times 11 \times 10 \times 9 \times 8}{5 \times 4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 1} = 792$.
